name: Claude Code skill example
headline: Claude Code skill example - sample skills
short_description: Automates software development workflows by creating worktrees from plan mode, implementing code, generating pull requests, and cleaning up worktrees. Benefits operations teams by streamlining development processes and integrating with Git workflows.
author: shikajiro

sections.overview:
Claude Code Skill Example automates software development workflows by integrating with Git worktrees and pull request management. The skill creates isolated worktrees when plan mode completes, allowing safe implementation of code changes before merging. After implementation finishes, it automatically generates pull requests and removes worktrees, streamlining the development cycle. This skill helps operations and development teams reduce manual Git workflow steps and maintain consistent branching practices across projects.
Automated worktree creation at the start of implementation phase
Streamlined pull request generation after code implementation
Automatic cleanup of worktrees following PR creation
Consistent Git workflow management across multiple projects
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/shikajiro/claude-code-skill-example`
sections.usage:
```
Create a new worktree from plan mode for [PROJECT_NAME] in [REPOSITORY]. Implement the following features: [FEATURE_LIST]. Generate a pull request with the title '[TITLE]' and description '[DESCRIPTION]'. Clean up the worktree after completion. Use the following Git workflow: [WORKFLOW].
```
